programs.title: Arrival
programs.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programs.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programs.desc: The Herdman clan has a bad reputation in the town.Unruly siblings steal and bully their peers.Wherever he appears, he causes chaos and goes completely unpunished.Meanwhile, the residents, under the direction of the newly elected organizer, Grace (Judy Greer), are preparing for the annual Christmas nativity play.To everyone's surprise, Gladys Herdman (Kynlee Heiman) and her relatives want to appear in the show.Grace casts a girl as Mary, which complicates preparations for the play and causes widespread dissatisfaction.

programs.title: Widow Clicquot
programs.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programs.title: The Front Runner
programs.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programs.title: Industry
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of young bankers in Great Britain.Pierpoint, Harper (Myha'la) and Yasmin (Marisa Abela) live the lavish life they dreamed of as graduates.The financiers are drawn into a tense game when a fintech genius appears on the London scene.Yasmin develops a relationship with Sir Henry Muck (Kit Harington), and Harper is drawn into the web of influence of the mysterious director, Whitney Halberstram (Max Minghella).Under the pressure of money and power, the friendship of young women is put to the test.

programs.title: The Knick 2
programs.desc: The further fate of the staff of New York's Knickerbocker Hospital.Dr. Thackery is in a New England rehab clinic trying to break free from addiction.The team tries to cope in his absence.
